parsedVerdict.reasoning: MileageService is declared in the business (domain) layer, but it does persistence work itself. It does not hand storage off to a repository abstraction. Instead it builds Prisma ORM calls directly: it picks the table (prisma.mileage), shapes the record, builds the storage key (`${plate}@${km}`), stamps the record time (readAt: new Date()) and writes the query criteria (findMany({ where: { plate } })). These jobs belong in the infrastructure layer. The domain logic is correct where it is: the service-interval check and the average-daily-distance calculation. The problem is that persistence logic sits in the same domain file. The direction of the imports is out of scope; this finding is only about which layer each responsibility belongs to.
